source: Curated from state board-of-pharmacy / drug repository program statutes. Review against the authoritative statute before relying on any entry.

states.notes: Texas accepts a broad range of sealed donations via charitable pharmacies (Health & Safety Code Ch. 442).
Ohio's Drug Repository Program accepts most non-controlled, sealed medications (ORC 3715.871).
California requires county program participation; longer shelf life preferred (H&S Code 150200+).
Iowa SafeNetRx is a mature statewide repository.
New York's Medication Donation/Reuse program operates through participating facilities.
Florida's cancer/prescription drug donation program runs through enrolled pharmacies.
Washington's Prescription Drug Take-Back & repository programs accept sealed donations.
